score_observations: Legend explicitly defines slap,harmonics,bisbigliando,quarter tones and ten multiphonic fingerings(not transposed); score written in C. Piano instructions include silent key depression and partial key release to obtain resonance.

Opening printedp5,3/4 quarter60,slap interruptions,held microtonal notes,bisbigliando and a marked multiphonic passage; piano sustaining pedal and sparse resonant attacks. SectionA atbar13 moves toquarter96 with sustained-pitch melody and chromatic inflections.
